privacy.label: Legal
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1_p: Team Cargo is a driver recruitment agency based in Amsterdam, Netherlands. We connect drivers with logistics companies and support them with job placement, documentation, and accommodation.
privacy.s2_intro: We may collect the following personal data:
s2_items: Identification or documentation (if required for employment)
s3_items: Match you with suitable job opportunities
privacy.s4_intro: We process your data based on:
s4_items: Your consent (when you apply or contact us)
privacy.s5_intro: We may share your data with:
s5_items: Partner logistics companies (e.g. GLS, FedEx, Amazon, DPD — for job placement)
Government or legal authorities (if required by law)
privacy.s5_no_sell: We do not sell your personal data.
privacy.s6_p: We keep your data only as long as necessary for recruitment purposes or as required by law.
privacy.s7_intro: Under GDPR, you have the right to:
s7_items: File a complaint with the Dutch Data Protection Authority (Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens)
privacy.s8_p: We take appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, loss, or misuse.
privacy.s9_intro: If you have questions or requests regarding this Privacy Policy, please contact us:
privacy.s10_p: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Please check this page regularly for the latest version.

cookies_page.label: Legal
cookies_page.title: Cookie Policy
cookies_page.s1_p: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help us improve your experience and allow certain website functions to work correctly.
cookies_page.s2_essential_p: Required for the website to function properly — e.g. navigation, forms, and session management. These cannot be disabled.
cookies_page.s2_analytics_p: Help us understand how visitors use our website (e.g. pages visited, time spent). We use this to improve the site.
cookies_page.s2_functional_p: Remember your preferences — such as your language selection — so you don't have to re-select it each visit.
s3_items: Improve website performance and user experience
Understand how users interact with our content
cookies_page.s4_p1: You can control or disable cookies through your browser settings. Please note that disabling certain cookies may affect the functionality of our website.
cookies_page.s4_p2: Most browsers allow you to: view stored cookies, delete cookies, and block cookies from specific or all websites. Refer to your browser's help documentation for instructions.
cookies_page.s5_p: We may use third-party services (such as analytics tools) that place their own cookies on your device. These are subject to their own privacy and cookie policies.
cookies_page.s6_p: When you first visit our website, we ask for your consent to use non-essential cookies. You can change your preferences at any time by clearing your browser cookies and revisiting the site.
cookies_page.s8_p: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page.
